description:
A self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality.

Creality Print is a self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality. It’s a practical and easy-to-use tool that can help you remote control and monitor your 3D printer and help print directly from your computer.
1. Added support for Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Thai, with further improvements to Japanese translations.

2. Enabled the AI Assistant to answer questions using the current printer, loaded filament, software version, and other runtime context.

3. Added AI Parameter Recommendation support for 17 additional print settings covering supports, infill, wall generation, and more.

4. Added multi-printer print dispatch support for SPARKX i7.

5. Fixed an issue where Fuzzy Skin Point Distance and Fuzzy Skin Thickness settings were not displayed.

6. Fixed Linux issues related to crashes on exit and preset editing.

7. Fixed an issue where the application continued occupying memory after being closed.

8. Fixed crashes when deleting certain models from 3MF projects or arranging multiple imported STL files.

9. Improved re-slicing performance and fixed slicing crashes related to Paint-on Supports and Tree Supports.

10. Fixed issues involving the Prepare page, WAN camera live view, and AI command execution.
